verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'As the Artemis II countdown moves steadily toward liftoff no earlier than 6:24 p.m. EDT, Wednesday, April 1... at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida... verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II will send NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and CSA... astronaut Jeremy Hansen on an approximately 10-day journey around the Moon'; R2: 'The Artemis II mission will be the first crewed mission under Artemis and send four astronauts around the Moon and back'; R3: 'four astronauts it will send on a journey around the moon'; R4: 'send a crew of four astronauts on a trailblazing nine-day trip around the moon and back'; R5: 'The first crewed Artemis flight... Crewed Lunar Flyby... carrying astronauts farther from Earth and closer to the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state Artemis II sends four astronauts around the Moon and back.
